translations.web: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?
translations.bsb: How can you believe if you accept glory from one another, yet do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
translations.kjv: How can ye believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that cometh from God only?
translations.asv: How can ye believe, who receive glory one of another, and the glory that cometh from the only God ye seek not?
